claim: DINOv2 ViT-S/14 baseline achieves higher R@1 and MRR than ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-50
limitation: ResNet-50 achieved higher R@5 and R@10 (1.0000 vs 0.9906); patch localization not directly measured
recommended_wording: On the evaluated held-out Zeiss Gemini retrieval benchmark, DINOv2 achieved higher R@1 and MRR than the ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-50 baseline, while ResNet-50 achieved higher R@5/R@10.

claim: Supervised contrastive adaptation B4 delivers highest precision at rank 5
limitation: Requires domain-labeled classes for contrastive adaptation
recommended_wording: Supervised contrastive fine-tuning yielded the highest top-5 precision density (P@5 = 0.9053 vs 0.8670 for ResNet-50).

claim: Token pooling ablation confirms patch tokens retain microstructural texture
limitation: Evaluated on static frozen ViT patch tokens without spatial cross-attention
recommended_wording: Ablation analysis indicates that patch-level token representations outperform global CLS token representations for microstructural retrieval.

claim: Conditioning visual representations on evaluated metadata configuration using a gated MLP reduced retrieval performance
scope: Zeiss GeminiSEM with 7 standardized metadata fields
limitation: Evaluated on standardized acquisition metadata; causality is hypothesized rather than physically proven
recommended_wording: On this benchmark, conditioning the visual representation on the evaluated metadata configuration reduced retrieval performance.

claim: Preliminary transfer to biological TEM yields moderate zero-shot retrieval that improves under fine-tuning
limitation: Preliminary biological subset; does not cover diffraction contrast or cryo-TEM
recommended_wording: Preliminary cross-domain evaluation demonstrates viable zero-shot transfer to biological TEM micrographs.

claim: Retrieval shows graceful degradation under controlled synthetic perturbations with severe degradation under defocus blur
limitation: Controlled mathematical perturbations rather than field microscope measurements
recommended_wording: The model showed degradation under controlled image perturbations, with severe defocus blur reducing R@1 retention to 48%.

claim: Engineering stress test demonstrates sub-millisecond vector retrieval scaling up to 100K vectors on host CPU hardware
scope: Synthetic replicated vector index based on DINOv2 embeddings
limitation: Engineering stress test using synthetic vectors
location: An engineering stress test evaluated vector-index behavior up to 100K vectors, maintaining sub-millisecond query latency under FAISS HNSW.

claim: Forensic analysis categorizes 11 false nearest neighbor benchmark errors across four structural failure modes
limitation: Benchmark errors against designated positive class; not physical defect falsity
recommended_wording: Forensic analysis of the 11 top-1 retrieval errors identified four recurring failure modes: carbide ambiguity, BSE contrast clipping, beam drift, and scale-bar incursions.

claim: Expert-in-the-loop double-blind triage review demonstrated substantial inter-annotator agreement
scope: 100 stratified review queue images evaluated by two specialists
limitation: Consensus categories reflect expert-identified novelty/quality cases rather than external physical ground truth
recommended_wording: Double-blind review across 100 triage events demonstrated substantial inter-annotator agreement (Cohen's Kappa = 0.842) for expert-identified novelty and quality cases.

claim: Nearest-neighbor retrieval-score margin heuristic exhibits score compression and limited discriminative calibration
limitation: Score margin is not a calibrated confidence probability (AUROC = 0.5146)
recommended_wording: Evaluation of the nearest-neighbor score margin revealed score compression and limited discriminative power (AUROC = 0.5146) for predicting retrieval correctness.

claim: Host platform verified across 14 of 15 criteria with 218 passing tests while container runtime is truthfully reported as unexecuted
limitation: Host verified on Windows 11; container runtime unexecuted due to inactive daemon
recommended_wording: The platform passed 14 of 15 hardening criteria and 218 unit/integration tests natively on the host, while containerized deployment was not executed due to host environment limitations.

claim: Broad claims of multi-tenant enterprise deployment and federated laboratory networks
limitation: Unimplemented speculative architecture; not evaluated in Phase 13
recommended_wording: The platform architecture is designed with modular interfaces to support future multi-tenant and federated deployments.

claim: Claims that DINOv2 ViT-S/14 is universally superior to convolutional architectures
recommended_wording: Do not use absolute claims of architectural superiority; restrict scope strictly to the evaluated benchmark.

claim: Claims that metadata causally damages visual retrieval representations
recommended_wording: Do not make causal claims; use 'conditioning on the evaluated metadata configuration reduced retrieval performance'.

claim: Claims that the curation system identifies absolute ground-truth physical anomalies
limitation: No external destructive metallographic ground truth exists
recommended_wording: Do not use 'True Anomalies'; use 'Expert-identified novelty/quality cases'.
